ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the B3-2,
Community Shopping District and indications as shown on Map No. 15-J in the area
bound by:

      The alley next north of and parallel to West Bryn Mawr Avenue; a line 28.74 feet east of
      and parallel to North Spaulding Avenue; West Bryn Mawr Avenue; and North Spaulding
      Avenue,

to those of a B1-2, Neighborhood Shopping District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                          ___________________________
                                                          Samantha Nugent
                                                          Alderman, 39th Ward




Common Address:
3256 W. Bryn Mawr Avenue
